headline: Indian staffing firms move from flat fees to output-based models
hook: Staffing firms shift to performance-based billing
summary: Major staffing companies including Quess and TeamLease are transitioning clients from flat-fee structures to output-based billing. Under this new model, vendors take direct responsibility for workforce performance and productivity metrics. Firms now face financial penalties for missing targets while gaining potential bonuses for exceeding delivery goals. This shift reflects a broader corporate push to link labor costs directly to measurable business outcomes.
why_it_matters: Staffing firms face higher operational risk but potential for better margins.
winners_losers: High-performing staffing firms gain / inefficient vendors hurt
